title: Same Tree
prompt: Given the roots of two binary trees p and q, write a function to check if they are the same or not. Two binary trees are the same if they are structurally identical, and the nodes have the same value.
hints: Base case: both null -> true. One null and one not -> false. Values different -> false.
Recursive: check if values match, then recursively check isSameTree(p.left, q.left) && isSameTree(p.right, q.right).
